feed_identity_review.previous_finding: Local input identity differed from census fallback identity, causing one redundant same-source job on first local-to-Hub reingestion.
feed_identity_review.validation_scope: Native training and cold restart ran before the feed-only patch; retained native outputs exercised the final feed code with no new training. Future producer-pinned campaigns must bind the updated feed hash.

limitations: Synthetic minimum-duration fixtures qualify the deterministic source compiler/decompiler and source-locked Lake numeric pattern. The real 5 USC 8410 span fails semantic, family-syntax and Lake gates.

Tuning validation is disjoint but is not a held-out generalization canary.
Training starts in a fresh process with disk metric cache disabled; in-process target reuse is allowed.
No speedup is asserted against the earlier three-sentence bridge baseline because samples and projection-family bounds differ.
Process lifetime overlap supports concurrent native training processes, not directly observed simultaneous projection kernels.
